visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing a green beanie and tan sweatshirt, sits at a white marble table in a well-lit living room. He smiles and looks directly at the camera while holding a vibrant green square tin with yellow paint-drip designs on the side. Behind him, a soft pink couch and a decorative shelf are visible. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the green tin being held in his hands. The lid of the tin features the white printed logos of "MINECRAFT X FOSSIL" against the lime-green background. His fingers are clearly visible as he grips the edges of the box. (3) Transition to a close-up of the watch on his wrist. The watch face shows a pixelated landscape of green grass and brown earth. The metal casing is silver with a textured bezel, and the hands are shaped like Minecraft tools. The background is slightly blurred showing indoor items. (4) The shot returns to the man at the table. He is now opening the lid of the tin box. He tilts the box towards the camera to show the watch nested inside a green foam interior. His facial expression is enthusiastic as he talks. (5) A static close-up of the watch resting inside the open tin box. The lighting highlights the reflective surface of the watch glass and the intricate pixel patterns on the face. The green foam provides a high-contrast background for the brown watch face. (6) Series of close-up shots showing the watch from different angles. The man's hands rotate the watch to show the silver casing, the textured bezel, and the brown leather strap. The back of the watch is shown, revealing engraved logos and serial numbers on the metal plate. (7) Final shot of the man holding the product up. He smiles warmly at the camera, conveying a sense of satisfaction. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting both the character and the product clearly in the center of the frame.
